channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Coluna da Tribuna: A posição de Rodolfo
item.description: Following the removal of Guto Silva as the PSD's candidate for governor of Paraná, Apucarana's mayor Rodolfo Mota (União Brasil) is emerging as a potential contender in the state race. His position gains relevance in the state political landscape, particularly after Silva's departure from the PSD.

item.title: Nikolas diz a Flávio que sofre provocações há 3 anos e cita clima “que ninguém mais suporta”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) said he has endured provocations for three years and criticized the current political climate as unbearable, noting he has a personal limit amid mutual accusations with Bolsonarist allies. His comments came during a public exchange of criticisms with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) regarding the latter’s presidential campaign.

item.title: Wilson Pedroso na Crusoé: O algoritmo de Barcelona e a mordaça de veludo
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Pedro Sánchez in Spain was framed as a triumph of progressive diplomacy, with the Barcelona Pact promising to regulate big techs and align AI with democratic values. However, behind the scenes in Brasília, the enthusiasm stems from less noble motives, such as using regulation to suppress criticism under the guise of fighting disinformation. The article warns the agreement could become a 'velvet gag' to silence opponents.

item.title: PEC da escala 6×1: texto avança e abre disputa sobre compensação ao setor produtivo
item.description: The 6×1 workweek PEC, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 36, was unanimously approved in the Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee. The government sees it as a boost for Lula’s 2026 re-election bid, but rapporteur Paulo Azi calls for fiscal compensation to businesses and a four-year transition, facing opposition from government allies. The bill now moves to a special committee, where amendments are expected — including one by Reginaldo Lopes to raise the weekly hours to 40 (5×2 schedule).

item.title: Entenda o embate entre Zema e Gilmar Mendes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes filed a criminal complaint against presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) over a satirical video depicting justices as puppets, claiming Zema is exploiting the electoral moment. Zema retaliated, accusing the STF of persecution, calling it 'rotten' and defending his right to free speech, arguing that critics cannot tolerate jokes.

item.title: Botafogo x Internacional: torcedores projetam jogão no Mané Garrincha
item.description: Fans of Botafogo and Internacional gathered at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília for the Brazilian Série A matchup in the 13th round. Botafogo supporter Pedro Koenigkan emphasized the importance of the win for the team’s season and Libertadores qualification hopes, predicting a 2-0 victory with goals from Danilo and Artur Cabral. The match, held at 6:30 PM on Saturday, April 25, was organized by Metrópoles Sports.

item.title: Do campo de futebol para os vinhedos
item.description: Jussiê Vieira, a former professional striker for Cruzeiro and Bordeaux, retired from football and is now the Clarets importer’s ambassador in Brazil, bringing renowned French wines like Ramonet and Dujac to the country. He organizes an annual football tournament in Chassagne-Montrachet, Burgundy, featuring former players, wine producers and their families, infused with Brazilian culture through samba, caipirinha and feijoada. His journey spans from the football fields of Nova Venécia (ES) to the vineyards of France, overcoming a difficult childhood to become a wine reference.

item.title: A inspiração para Bolsonaro e seus asseclas para o 'gabinete do ódio'
item.description: The launch of the anthology 'Segundo governo Vargas: História & historiografia', organized by Maycon Dougllas by CPDOC/FGV and Editora Cancioneiro, was cited as an inspiration for Bolsonaro and his allies in forming the so-called 'cabinet of hate'. The content is available only to subscribers, requiring registration for full access. The reference suggests an ideological link between Vargas’s legacy and the current far-right political agenda in Brazil.

item.title: Inadimplência está perto do pico em várias modalidades de crédito
item.description: Credit delinquency in Brazil is nearing record levels across vehicle purchases, other goods, consigned and non-consigned credit, and credit card revolving balances, according to Central Bank data. Despite low unemployment (5.8% in February 2026), households are not directing income gains toward debt repayment due to high interest rates (Selic at 14.75% per year). The Lula administration faces criticism for fiscal expansion (R$42.3 billion in 'bondade' measures) clashing with monetary tightening, while preparing 'Desenrola 2.0' to renegotiate debts for families, informal workers, and small businesses.

item.title: Deputado aciona Justiça contra licitação do STF para monitorar redes
item.description: State deputy Leandro de Jesus (PL) filed a popular action against an STF bidding process worth R$ 249,000 for real-time social media monitoring of mentions to the Court and its ministers, arguing it threatens freedom of expression. The tender calls for daily and monthly reports analyzing public sentiment (positive, neutral, or negative) about the STF, focusing on topics directly related to its rulings and justices.

item.title: Vitória de Lula pode ser tão estratégica para Trump quanto a de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz professor Guilherme Casarões
item.description: Professor Guilherme Casarões of Florida International University states that, despite a good rapport between Trump and Lula, the U.S. government may prefer to remain neutral in Brazil’s October elections, avoiding explicit support for Flávio Bolsonaro. He suggests Trump might view a Brazil under Lula as strategically valuable due to its potential to engage with Latin American nations like Venezuela, which could be as advantageous as having a submissive ally. However, he warns that Lula’s main vulnerability lies in public security, with the risk that the Trump administration could label Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist organizations, threatening national sovereignty.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio Bolsonaro ganha espaço nas redes de olho no eleitorado feminino: ‘Reeduquei ele’
item.description: Fernanda Antunes Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), has gained prominence in her husband's social media as part of a strategy to attract female voters. In recent posts, she appears in videos showing family routines, including interactions with their daughters and comments like 'I re-educated him', reinforcing the image of Flávio as a 'moderate Bolsonaro' more aligned with women's issues. The approach aims to humanize the candidate and contrast with the perception of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Plataformas de previsões no alvo: entenda o vácuo regulatório que o BC decidiu fechar
item.description: The federal government has banned the operation of predictive market platforms in Brazil, which allowed users to bet on events such as election outcomes, economic indicators, and reality show winners. The measure, announced by the Central Bank, aims to close a regulatory vacuum that had enabled these platforms to operate without proper oversight. The decision was taken to mitigate risks of manipulation, money laundering, and inappropriate consumer exposure to high-risk betting in sensitive contexts like elections.

item.title: 'Impacto ambiental' x 'melhoramento': entenda a disputa entre ONGs e o governo Lula sobre a BR-319, que corta a Amazônia
item.description: The Climate Observatory, a coalition of 161 environmental NGOs, has sued the Brazilian government over DNIT’s tender notices to pave 339.4 km of the BR-319 highway, arguing that the Lula administration is using a controversial environmental licensing flexibility law — previously vetoed by Lula himself — to fast-track the project before completing required environmental assessments. The move risks accelerating deforestation in one of the Amazon’s most preserved areas. While local authorities support the road for regional integration, environmentalists demand full licensing. The AGU justified the action by classifying the paving as 'maintenance or improvement' of existing infrastructure, allowing exemption from impact studies under the new law.

item.title: 'Nada a ser atendido': entenda a decisão de Zanin que manteve desembargador como governador interino do Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Judge Ricardo Couto, must remain in office despite the election of Douglas Ruas as president of the State Legislative Assembly. The decision upholds the prior ruling that Couto should serve until the Court rules on the format of the interim election for the state executive. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: 'Dona Maria:' PT vai à Justiça contra personagem de IA criada por motorista de app por propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The PT, PV, and PC do B parties filed a request with Electoral Justice to suspend the 'Dona Maria' AI-generated profile, which criticizes President Lula’s government, alleging premature electoral propaganda. The profile, created by an app driver, has garnered over 102 million views on Instagram and uses AI to depict a middle-aged woman, avoiding direct naming of politicians while maintaining a strongly oppositional tone.

item.title: Congresso do PT debate plano de governo de Lula e multilateralismo
item.description: The 8th PT Congress is debating the government plan for a potential fourth term of Lula, focusing on energy transition, critical minerals exploration, and building a technologically based national industry. Lula, in a video message, urged militants to propose feasible and executable ideas, stressing that governments win elections by showing what they’ve done. Edinho Silva advocated for political system reform and a judiciary reform that strengthens rather than weakens the power, including increased civil society representation in the CNJ.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Motta sinalizam apoio a projeto sobre combustíveis; governo quer acelerar votação
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signaled support for the government's proposal to temporarily reduce federal fuel taxes during international conflicts affecting oil prices. The administration seeks to fast-track the bill via urgency regime, bypassing committee review. The proposal also includes royalty compensation for states impacted by the tax exemption.

item.title: Veja imagens da abertura do 8º Congresso Nacional do PT
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) held the opening of its 8th National Congress in Brasília, focusing on its 2026 electoral strategy, which involves comparing Lula’s legacy to what it calls the 'Brazil of destruction' under Bolsonaro. Lula, recovering from surgery, did not attend in person but sent a video and was represented by totems at the event. The congress also featured support for Nicolás Maduro and strong rhetoric labeling Bolsonarism as 'far-right' and 'fascist'.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Judiciário deve conduzir a própria reforma
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva advocated for a judiciary-led reform, involving judges, jurists, civil society, and academia, during the opening of the party’s 8th National Congress in Brasília. He stressed the need to align government support with the party’s structural agenda and noted that constitutional changes require congressional action, reinforcing the PT’s 2026 strategy to boost its representation, especially in the Senate. Edinho also warned against efforts to weaken the judiciary by Bolsonaro-aligned groups, linking them to threats to Brazilian democracy.

item.title: PT defende volta de Nicolás Maduro para a Venezuela
item.description: The PT defended the return of Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores to Venezuela during its 8th congress, displaying a banner with the phrase 'los queremos de vuelta' and unfurling a Venezuelan flag. The couple was captured by U.S. forces in January 2026 and is detained in New York on drug trafficking charges. Lula had previously argued that Maduro should be tried in Venezuela, stating that the arrest of a president by another country is unacceptable.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que modelo político “não serve” ao partido
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the Workers' Party (PT), stated that Brazil's current political model does not represent the party and must be confronted, linking his critique to economic financialization, income concentration, and the long crisis of capitalism. He asserted that the PT has moral authority to fight corruption, citing Lula as the figure who demanded investigations into the INSS and Banco Master scandals, and framed the 2026 dispute as a struggle for Brazil's future, not merely an ordinary election.

item.title: O que são terras-raras e minerais críticos, que motivaram venda de mineradora em Goiás
item.description: The sale of Brazil's Serra Verde mining company, the only commercial rare earths operation outside Asia, to American firm USA Rare Earth for $2.8 billion sparked political debate, with Lula's allies urging the PGR to investigate. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves after China, and these 17 chemical elements are vital for strategic technologies including EV batteries, semiconductors, wind turbines and weapons, making them central to the U.S.-China technological rivalry.

item.title: Não é só no Brasil: veja como outros países estão apertando o cerco a mercados preditivos
item.description: The Brazilian government has banned predictive market platforms where users bet on election outcomes, economic forecasts, reality show winners, and other events. Announced on Friday, the move aims to curb speculative and potentially manipulative activities. Full access to the article requires a subscription.

item.title: Em vídeo após cirurgia, Lula manda petistas “irem panfletar”
item.description: Lula, recovering from surgery to remove a basal cell carcinoma on his scalp, sent a video to the 8th National Congress of the PT in Brasília, where he criticized digital activism and urged party militants to engage in grassroots politics by handing out flyers and speaking directly to voters. He clearly signaled his intention to run for a fourth term in 2026, stating: 'Get ready for the following: I will be president again.' In the video, he highlighted government achievements such as GDP growth above 3%, low inflation, minimum wage increases, and investments in education and health, arguing that the PT should campaign on demonstrated results rather than unfulfillable promises.

item.title: Não será trivial Lula negar ajuda ao BRB
item.description: President Lula faces political difficulty in denying the National Treasury’s backing for a R$6.6 billion loan requested by the Federal District government to save BRB, in an election year that heightens scrutiny over fiscally sensitive decisions.

item.title: Mudanças nos programas habitacionais aquecem crédito para a classe média, mas juros são entrave
item.description: The Lula government and the construction sector are seeking to stimulate real estate financing for the middle class, but high interest rates and restricted credit access remain obstacles. While the luxury and popular housing segments are heating up, middle-class financing is still seen as a bottleneck, despite recent incentive measures.

item.title: Economistas criticam uso de receita do petróleo para desoneração de combustíveis
item.description: Economists criticized the Lula government’s decision to use extraordinary oil revenues to reduce taxes on gasoline and ethanol, interpreting the move as a sign of little willingness to improve public finances.

item.title: PT quer comparar Lula e Bolsonaro, mas presidente diz que isso não basta
item.description: President Lula stated that the PT's 2026 election strategy must focus on comparing his government's reconstruction legacy with the alleged destruction under Bolsonaro, emphasizing the need to convince voters through demonstrated achievements. He stressed that the election is not just a political contest but a battle for Brazil's future, urging the party to present its own project clearly rather than relying solely on attacks. PT national president Edinho Silva endorsed the approach, labeling Bolsonarism as 'ultright' and 'fascist', and insisted the campaign must highlight Lula's record while demanding opponents clarify their plans.

item.title: Zema se apresenta como candidato “antissistema” em vídeo de campanha
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo party, released a campaign video positioning himself as an 'anti-system' candidate, criticizing privileges in public office and claiming he cut spending and challenged 'untouchable' groups during his tenure. He referenced Operation Lava Jato, Dilma Rousseff’s impeachment, and former governor Fernando Pimentel (PT), stating his 2022 re-election proved it is possible to 'defeat the system' and that Minas Gerais’ model can be replicated nationally.

item.title: Lula diz que instituições precisam de reforma e que PT deve ter propostas factíveis
item.description: President Lula (PT) sent a video message to the opening of the PT's 8th Congress, calling for institutional reform and urging his party to present feasible proposals. He emphasized that democratic institutions must be updated to address contemporary challenges and that the PT must act with realism and technical viability. The video was recorded and played during the event held on Friday, April 24, 2026.

item.title: Lula convoca militância do PT para campanha: ‘política se faz olhando no olho, não no sofá e no zap’
item.description: President Lula called on PT militants to take to the streets in the 2026 campaign, criticizing overreliance on WhatsApp and advocating for face-to-face voter engagement. He stated he is in good health after a medical procedure and reaffirmed his re-election bid, saying politics is made by looking people in the eyes. The PT removed all references to Banco Master and Jair Bolsonaro from its 'Building the Future' manifesto, replacing them with generic terms, as requested by the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Em evento do PT, Lula diz que 'não corre atrás de adversários' e que governo não perderá eleição se fizer ‘as coisas corretas’
item.description: Lula stated that the PT does not chase opponents and will not lose the election if it does 'the right things'. He emphasized that the governing party is pursued by adversaries and expressed confidence in winning the 2026 elections, despite his physical absence due to medical procedures.

item.title: Lula diz em evento do PT que ‘não precisa correr atrás de adversários’ e prega reformas das instituições
item.description: Lula stated that the PT, as the governing party, does not need to chase opponents, but rather opponents must demonstrate their differences. He also advocated for institutional reforms, particularly of the Judiciary, amid debates over its credibility. The remarks were made at the close of the first day of the PT Congress in Brasília, where the party is drafting the foundation for his re-election campaign.

item.title: PT coloca Lula em comercial falando a favor do fim da 6 X 1
item.description: The PT aired a commercial featuring Lula advocating for the end of the 6x1 work schedule, emphasizing its impact on working mothers and guaranteeing no salary reduction. The ad's broadcast coincides with the formation of a special committee in the Chamber of Deputies to discuss PEC 221/2019, which proposes reducing the workweek.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se pronuncia após briga, e Nikolas fala em ‘clima que ninguém mais suporta’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appealed for unity in his presidential campaign, rejecting excessive pressure and demands from allies, stating that support must be earned, not imposed. Nikolas Ferreira, while reaffirming his support for Flávio, criticized the 'climate that no one can tolerate anymore' within the group, denouncing internal persecution, 'traitor' labels, and arbitrary demands such as posting frequency, arguing that each should act according to their role without imposition.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia propõe criação de ‘brigadas eleitorais para candidatas mulheres’ nas eleições 2026
item.description: Supreme Federal Tribunal Minister Cármen Lúcia proposed the creation of electoral brigades for female candidates in the 2026 elections, drawing inspiration from the Maria da Penha brigades to combat gender-based political violence. She emphasized that, as former president of the TSE in the 2024 municipal elections, she observed the need for preventive mechanisms to ensure women's safety and full participation in politics. The initiative aims to prevent escalation of violence during campaigns and foster a safer, more democratic electoral environment.

item.title: Malafaia parabeniza Gilmar: “Nessa questão ele acertou!”
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia praised Minister Gilmar Mendes for acknowledging a mistake in a controversial statement implying that Romeu Zema, the governor-elect of Minas Gerais, could be homosexual. Malafaia commended Mendes for his humility in admitting the error, highlighting the virtue of taking responsibility.

item.title: Alckmin diz ao PT que “sempre foi bem recebido” no partido
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) attended the 8th National Congress of the PT and stated he had always been warmly received by party members, despite his past opposition, including supporting Dilma Rousseff’s impeachment in 2016. He emphasized his loyalty to President Lula, credited him with saving Brazilian democracy after the January 8 attacks, and praised policies such as the provisional EU-Mercosur agreement and tax reform. His presence was seen as a gesture of allegiance to Lula’s political project ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Nikolas diz a Flávio que é provocado 'há três anos' e rebate Carlos: 'Postar você todos os dias, qualquer um faz'
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira said he has been provoked for three years by allies of Flávio Bolsonaro but will remain silent to support his presidential bid, emphasizing that winning votes requires more than daily social media posts. He criticized Carlos Bolsonaro’s proposal to monitor allies who don’t promote Flávio’s candidacy, stating that 'posting you every day anyone can do,' while real work involves convincing through ideas. Ferreira also noted that despite calls for pacification, divisions within Bolsonarism persist, even over trivial matters like shirt color.

item.title: PT retira referência a ‘caso Master’ de manifesto divulgado pelo partido, a pedido do Planalto
item.description: The PT removed references to the 'Master case' and former President Jair Bolsonaro from its manifesto 'Building the Future' at the request of the Planalto, aiming to avoid direct mentions that could harm Lula's re-election campaign. The original text, which cited the Master scandal as a lesson for financial reform and mentioned Bolsonaro 15 times, was revised to use generic terms like 'previous government' and to drop the financial system reform, reducing the proposals from six to five. The change reflects the government's strategy to focus on consensus-driven proposals and postpone contentious debates until after the election.

item.title: Nunes Marques assume presidência do TSE dia 12 de maio
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques will assume the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on May 12, 2026, succeeding Minister Cármen Lúcia, whose two-year term ends on that date. The appointment follows seniority among TSE ministers who are also members of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), with Minister André Mendonça as vice-president. Marques, 53, a native of Teresina, was appointed to the STF by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020 and previously served as a judge at the TRF of the 1st Region and the TRE of Piauí.

item.title: Defesa de ex-assessor diz que decisão de Moraes sobre prisão é 'continuidade de abuso'
item.description: The defense of former presidential aide Filipe Martins said it received the news of Minister Alexandre de Moraes’ ruling with hope, stating that the STF minister’s decision to declare the case final and unappealable in Martins’ conviction for involvement in the coup plot constitutes a continuation of abuse of authority.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: entenda o que são e como funcionam as mesas receptoras de votos
item.description: The voting polling stations, defined by Resolution 23.751/2026 of the TSE, are the locations where voters will cast their ballots in the 2026 elections, with the first round on October 4 and a possible second round on October 25. Each station consists of a president, first and second poll worker, and a secretary, with preferential convocation of local voters over 18 years old in good standing with the Electoral Justice; in 2024, over 1.9 million people served in these roles. If members are absent, the president must notify the electoral judge, who may authorize reassignment, substitution with logistical support, or appointment of present voters.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes pede desculpas a Romeu Zema após citar homossexualidade
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes admitted he was wrong to mention homosexuality as a possible offense against former governor Romeu Zema during an interview. He apologized to Zema after the comment sparked controversy. Mendes, however, defended his decision to include Zema in the fake news investigation, which probes attacks on the Court.

item.title: Moraes declara trânsito em julgado de núcleo 2 da trama golpista e determina início das penas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes declared the transit in judgment of the convicted in nucleus 2 of the coup plot, ordering the start of sentence enforcement. All five convicted individuals were already in preventive detention, including General Mário Fernandes (26 years and 6 months), Silvinei Vasques (24 years and 6 months), Marcelo Costa Câmara (21 years), Filipe Martins (21 years), and Marília de Alencar (8 years and 6 months), with sentences maintained in closed regime or house arrest with electronic bracelet. Federal delegate Fernando Sousa de Oliveira was acquitted.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TRE-SP determina remoção de posts de deputado do PT
item.description: São Paulo’s Electoral Court (TRE-SP) ordered the removal of two paid Facebook posts by state deputy Antonio Donato (PT-SP) for alleged premature electoral campaigning in favor of Fernando Haddad and against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. Judge Maria Cláudia Bedotti ruled the posts, containing phrases like 'we are going to win this election,' constituted unequivocal electoral propaganda before the legal start date of August 15. Donato’s staff denied receiving notice and claimed Tarcísio is seeking to suppress criticism of a poll showing Haddad close to him.

item.title: Nunes Marques já tem data para assumir a presidência do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques will assume the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on May 12, following the early departure of Minister Cármen Lúcia. He was elected in an administrative session on April 14 and will be joined by Minister André Mendonça as vice-president. The new leadership will oversee the October municipal elections amid growing use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process.

item.title: Gilmar é “ator político” e presta “desserviço”, diz Vieira
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-AL) labeled Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes a 'political actor' who is doing a 'disservice' to Brazilian justice, in response to Mendes' suggestion that Vieira might be financed by organized crime. Vieira defended the final report of the CPI on Organized Crime, stating it investigates atypical conduct in high institutions, including the Judiciary, and that Mendes' aggressive reaction reveals arrogance and a presumed sense of impunity.

item.title: Em manifesto, PT prevê debate sobre reforma administrativa e do Judiciário
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) will discuss a political manifesto in Brasília to define electoral strategies for 2026 and party guidelines, including proposals for administrative, Judiciary, political, electoral, tax, and technological reforms. The document states these reforms are 'decisive' for the democratic-popular project and warns of the global advance of the far-right. Lula’s participation in the congress closing remains unconfirmed due to a recent medical procedure.
